name: Journey to the Void
detailed_description:
Feature List

Explore 25 unique arenas across 8 different biomes. Choose your starting location and build your deck with their region-exclusive cards to create unique playthroughs each time.

Over 300 cards, items and weapons to gear up with and experiment with their range of powers and effects. 

Face 120+ different enemies, 10 bosses, a range of grunts and some rather deceptively cute salamanders. Study their weaknesses, exploit synergies, and use your strategy to emerge victorious.

Every new run, choose an unwilling hero to attempt to save this corrupt world. Each “hero” has traits which may work in your favour… or against you.

Use essence to level up your hero and build stats to support your run. Do you value intelligence? Or is brute force the path you will take?

Over 100 interactions where you are forced to make a decision which will potentially cause game changing effects in this run and even future runs!


About the Game

Journey to the Void places you at the edge of a corrupted world,  commence your quest in one of eight biomes, battle relentless foes and uncover the source of the corruption.

In this hybrid roguelite strategy-deck builder, use your deck wisely, every choice and hand played could mean victory or defeat. Strategically stack attacks, unleash devastating abilities, and wield the power of the elements in your favour. Prepare to fend off attacks from all directions in a grid-based combat system, where your hero stands in the centre of the action.

Strategic Deckcraft

With over 100 unique cards, weapons, and items to discover, no two runs are ever the same. Build powerful deck synergies, fine-tune your strategy before each battle, and take on wave after wave of enemies. The right choices could mean survival… or else lead to a devastating defeat!

A Path of Choices

Encounter merchants, buy or sell rare trinkets, and prepare your hero for battle. As you journey deeper into the void, you will come face to face with encounters - each one presenting a crucial choice which could alter your fate for this run and future runs. Will you play it safe, or embrace the unknown? Every decision has consequences… and only the bold will thrive.

Heroes of the Void

At the start of every run, you’ll choose a brand-new hero, each hailing from different regions of the world. Each hero comes with distinct traits that can shape your fate, for better or worse. Gather XP points through combat and successful encounters to craft your ideal build by choosing how to level up your hero.

The Corrupted World

The world, divided into eight elemental regions, will permanently react to the multitude of choices you make. Choose your starting point wisely, with each region offering new heroes, powerful elemental cards and unique interactions to the region. Each time you play, experience completely unique runs within an overarching story, with over 100 enemies, 10 bosses, different starting decks and 25 arenas to discover.

short_description: Prepare to fend off attacks from all directions in this hybrid strategy roguelite deck builder. On your journey through varied grid-based biomes, battle unique foes and make tough moral choices to restore a corrupted land and decide the fate of your world.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian
reviews:
“Everything is big and bold, but also it felt quite measured, as I played cards from different decks and moved my avatar around grid based environments filled with monsters. It’s simple, clean, and accessible.”
Rogueliker

“Combining visual charm, decisions that increase replayability and fun gameplay, Journey to the Void has everything to be one of the big names among indies in 2025.”
Gamefoxhub

“One of the most intriguing features of the game is the impact of moral choices, which can permanently alter the regions visited and even modify future runs.”
SpazioGames
